subject: Post-call: $/1M targets + host benchmarking (regional split)
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: $/1M targets + host benchmarking (regional split)

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can put a pilot proposal together: 

Call highlights
- Primary use: patient triage + clinical note summarization (latency-sensitive sections) and embeddings for search.
- Expected steady-state usage: you estimated 50–100M tokens/month initially, with potential to scale to 200M+ in 6–12 months.
- Compliance: US PHI scope; preference for a private VPC deployment or Dedicated pool scoped to Acme.

Pricing & benchmarking (initial guidance) — see attached PDF for full table
- Redwood baseline target (suggested): $12–$25 per 1M tokens depending on model family and quantization level.
- Public hosts (typical ranges we see):
  • OpenAI (managed): $20–$80 / 1M (wide range driven by model + context length)
  • Anthropic (managed): $18–$70 / 1M (varies by model tier)
  • Open-model hosts / self-hosted providers: $6–$30 / 1M (depends on infra efficiency & pooling)
- Practical effective unit cost: with prefix caching and batching we often see 20–40% reduction on real workloads versus naive per-token math.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token tier (pick one): 0–50M / 50–100M / 100–200M / 200M+? That determines the firm tier pricing.
2) Target $/1M that would make a pilot + dedicated private deployment compelling for Acme (ballpark answer OK).
3) Any procurement timeline or PO process we should know about (procurement@acmehealth.com added here).

Ben & Lauren — looping you in for pricing guardrails and a quick check on our suggested ranges above. If the customer is US-PHI and wants private deployment, we’ll likely put a 30% uplift for dedicated infra + compliance add-ons; we should include that in the draft.

Sam — I attached a one-page benchmarking artifact and a simple volume worksheet. If you confirm the tier and target $/1M, I’ll draft a pilot proposal (30-day pilot, up to 50M tokens, monitoring + rollback SLA) and a suggested commercial sheet.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nsharma@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood-pricing-comparison-20260824.pdf (1 page), acme-volume-estimates.xlsx (stub)
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@acmehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: $/1M targets + host benchmarking (regional split)

Thanks, Nikhil — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Volume: leaning toward the 50–100M tokens/month band for the first 3 months, with a likely step up to 150–200M if the pilot goes well.
- Budget / target: Acme finance has an internal target around $15 / 1M tokens for inference (this is tight but achievable if we get batching + caching).
- Compliance: PHI is non-negotiable. We’d prefer Redwood Dedicated in us-west with customer-controlled keys.

Procurement: we’ll need an initial pilot SOW + anticipated commercial terms to start a PO. Procurement prefers line items (pilot fee, monthly committed tokens, overage rate $/1M).

Can you send a short proposal with 30-day pilot pricing that assumes 50M tokens (and the $/1M tiers if we scale)? Also, please include a comparison to OpenAI/Anthropic cost at the top level — procurement asks for clear benchmarking.

—Sam
Sam Walters
Head of Digital Products | Acme Health
sam.walters@acmehealth.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: $/1M targets + host benchmarking (regional split)

Appreciate the clarity, Sam — that helps a lot. Quick response and a draft commercial stance for procurement: 

Draft pilot commercial (30 days) — assumes US-PHI, Dedicated pool (us-west)
- Committed tokens: 50M (included)
- Pilot price (all-in): $15 / 1M tokens (aligned to your internal target) -> Pilot charge = $750
- Overage: $20 / 1M (applies above 50M during pilot)
- Compliance + Dedicated infra uplift: included in pilot fee; enterprise SLA available as add-on

Scale tiers (post-pilot; indicative):
- 50–100M: $14 / 1M
- 100–200M: $12 / 1M
- 200M+: $10 / 1M (requires 12-month committed capacity)

Benchmarking (high level)
- OpenAI managed: often $20–$60 / 1M for comparable models and contexts — managed but higher unit price for reliability and scale.
- Anthropic managed: similar band, $18–$55 / 1M depending on model.
- Open-model hosts (self-hosted with pooling): $6–$25 / 1M depending on quantization and infra utilization.

Notes on reducing effective cost
- Prefix & KV caching: can reduce token spend on repetitive prompts by ~15–35% depending on UX.
- Batching: reduces per-token compute cost and improves throughput; helps us hit lower tier pricing sooner.
- Model family and context length: choosing a 2k context optimizes price; longer contexts increase per-request compute.

Ben / Lauren — can you confirm the pilot commercial above is within pricing guardrails? Also dropping a link to the internal pricing sheet for procurement to reference.

Sam — if that looks good, I’ll convert to a short SOW + one-page pricing table (line items for pilot, overage, and optional 12-month committed tier). We can also include an explicit comparison line that shows Redwood vs OpenAI vs Anthropic for a 50M-month profile (I’ll add numbers in the SOW).

Thanks,
Nikhil
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: $/1M targets + host benchmarking (regional split)

Quick thumbs up from pricing — pilot price at $15 / 1M for 50M committed is acceptable as-is for a 30-day test. A couple of operational notes to include in the SOW: 
- Usage reporting cadence (daily token consumption and cost drill-down)
- Auto-scaling cap to prevent unexpected spend during tests
- Explicit rollback / termination clause at pilot end

Nikhil — feel free to push the SOW and one-pager. I’ll review line items and attach the internal cost model (link).

-Ben
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
